source: Duroflex client feedback, relayed by Neha on 25 Nov 2026
notes: Wardrobe references named by the client: Alo and Skims fitwear ('clean girl' aesthetic), for women and men. Brand names are kept here only as the record; they are never sent to the planner or the image model, so those brands' logos are not drawn. Casting (Neha, 25 Nov 2026): "the models (people) need to be indian. not any other ethnicity". Pop of colour (Neha, 25 Nov 2026: "Yes, all four", after the variety batch showed the pop barely visible): the client asked for "a little pop"; the pop field names the kind of object and colour so it reaches the picture. Client feedback relayed by Neha on 25 Nov 2026 (both brands): no full product name or variant name in copy, and "Direct it like a lifestyle/fashion brand - editorial shoot". Duroflex only, same day, with 29 reference pictures (kept locally in work/duroflex-models-rooms-20261125/, never in Git or the brand library): the client is "really particular about the models", who "can have imperfections - to make it look real not ai-ish"; ethnic wear such as sarees for festive pictures, otherwise outfits and models chosen for the picture's use. The rooms, pop, wardrobe, models and shoot lines were written from those pictures in words; the pictures themselves are never sent to the planner or the image model.
shoot: Shoot every picture like a premium lifestyle and fashion brand's editorial, not a catalogue or a furniture advert: editorial realism on film (a medium-format, Portra-like look: soft natural window light, gentle film grain, warm true-to-life colour, shallow depth of field, a 50-85 mm portrait-lens perspective). People are directed like editorial models in candid, in-between moments (laughing mid-conversation, reading, settling into the seat, looking out of the window) with relaxed hands and natural posture. Frames are considered and calm, with room to breathe; a close-up may crop into a face, hands or fabric like an editorial detail shot. Limbo shots read as an editorial studio portrait or still life on a warm seamless backdrop with one soft key light. The product stays sharp, accurate and the hero of the frame.
rooms: Warm, sophisticated contemporary Indian homes, shot like an interiors editorial: textured limewash or plaster walls in warm off-white, greige or stone; large windows with sheer white curtains and soft daylight; warm wood (oak, walnut or burl veneer), natural stone or marble, linen and wool; a few sculptural, collected pieces (a live-edge wooden side table, sculpted ceramics, a mushroom or column floor lamp, one large textured artwork, coffee-table books). Calm, uncluttered and lived-in, Japandi or Scandinavian in its restraint, with one small pop of colour. For a festive brief, the same kind of home in warm golden evening light with diyas, brass lanterns, a marigold garland and a carved or block-printed wooden headboard.
pop: Every room has one small but clearly visible pop of colour: a single object in a richer accent than the calm room around it, for example an oxblood floor lamp, an olive-green glazed ceramic, a rust or terracotta textured artwork, a terracotta vase or a mustard throw (a different one each time). Cushion, vase, lamp or artwork size, never a whole wall or large surface; placed where the eye lands, not lost in shadow. It is the one strong accent; the rest of the room stays calm.

avoidColours.text: No light blue and no light green on walls, backdrops, floors or other large background surfaces (a competitor uses light blue). This includes sky, baby, powder, ice, pastel and duck-egg blue, and mint, sage, pistachio, seafoam and pastel green.

ranges.name: Duropedic
ranges.person: Someone fit and active who works out and takes care of their body: an athletic, healthy build and an energetic, confident look.
ranges.space: A clean, contemporary, light-filled space with an active-lifestyle feel, for example one or two of: a rolled yoga mat, clean trainers, a water bottle, a resistance band, light dumbbells, a skipping rope, a foam roller or a bicycle by the door (a different one each time), in warm neutral and earthy tones.

ranges.name: Natural living (LiveIn, Energise and the Natural Living range)
ranges.person: Someone who lives sustainably and close to nature: relaxed, mindful and at ease.
ranges.space: An earthy, natural space: raw and light wood, linen, jute and cane, terracotta and clay, indoor plants and plenty of natural daylight.

cast: Every person is Indian: Indian women and men (and children when a page shows a family) with Indian features and natural Indian skin tones. Never people of another ethnicity.
models: The client is particular about the models: they look like real people photographed on film, never AI-perfect. Visible skin texture and pores, natural shine, freckles, moles and fine lines (laugh lines and crow's feet when they smile), natural under-eye shadows, uneven brows, stubble or a full moustache on men, natural flyaway, curly or wavy hair, a slight natural asymmetry, real hands and natural nails. Varied, healthy real bodies and ages (late 20s to 50s; a mother or an elder when the story is about family). Minimal natural make-up, richer for festive looks (kohl, a bindi). Candid, emotionally real expressions: a genuine laugh with crinkled eyes, a quiet confident look, eyes away mid-moment; never a posed catalogue smile. Never poreless, airbrushed, waxy, plastic or glossy skin, perfectly symmetrical faces or over-white teeth.
wardrobe: Dress each person for the picture's moment and use, styled like a premium fashion editorial in fabrics that look real (visible weave, natural creases), with no logos or words. Sleep and bedroom: a satin or cotton pyjama set with contrast piping, or a soft ribbed lounge set, a knit robe or long cardigan, barefoot. Lounging and everyday at home: relaxed linen or cotton shirts and trousers, a knit polo, an overshirt over a tee, in cream, white, navy, olive, rust, plum or brown. Fitness, wellness and the Duropedic range: quiet-luxury athleisure (a ribbed crop top or tank with flared or high-waist leggings, matching sets in sage, oat, navy or black, clean trainers). Work and study: tailored separates (a check blazer, a crisp white shirt, wide trousers, a leather tote). Festive briefs (Diwali, weddings, a festive sale): Indian ethnic wear: a silk saree with a gold zari border in deep red, maroon or emerald with kundan or temple jewellery, a gajra or roses in the bun and a bindi, or a handloom cotton saree; men in a dark embroidered kurta with a bandhgala or Nehru jacket, or a kurta-pyjama.
limboColours: One solid, warm or earthy colour: sand, oat, warm stone, clay, terracotta, ochre, rust, deep olive, charcoal or warm white; a stronger pop (terracotta, mustard or burnt orange) when the page needs energy. Never light blue or light green.
limboGraphics: Graphics stay calm and minimal: thin lines, small arrows or soft layer outlines, only where a feature needs explaining.
